name: EventRecord / Event

test_list.description: An EventRecord with every Event variant round-trips through JSON unchanged.
EventRecord::new stamps EVENT_SCHEMA_VERSION == 2; the v1 golden is retained through versioned construction.
Event is Copy (no heap payload: strings and blobs are Cid references into CAS) and its size stays <= 96 bytes.
insta snapshot of a representative EventRecord freezes the v1 JSON shape (wire-stability gate).

inputs.name: event
inputs.description: Domain event produced by a verified command or a supervisor.

output_description: Versioned envelope appended to the event store.
